words.definition: a curved shape or line, part of a circle
words.example: The bridge design follows a graceful arc.
words.exampleTranslation: 這座橋的設計呈現優雅的弧形。

words.definition: a short performance to test a person's suitability for a role
words.example: Actors will audition for the commercial next Monday.
words.exampleTranslation: 演員將在下週一試鏡這支廣告。

words.definition: a bag carried on the back, supported by straps over the shoulders
words.example: Employees received a company backpack as a welcome gift.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工收到一個公司後背包作為歡迎禮物。

words.definition: a large room used for dances or formal events
words.example: The awards ceremony will be held in the hotel's ballroom.
words.exampleTranslation: 頒獎典禮將在飯店的宴會廳舉行。

words.definition: producing good or helpful results
words.example: Flexible hours have proven beneficial for employee morale.
words.exampleTranslation: 彈性工時已被證實對員工士氣有益。

words.definition: an account of a person's life written by someone else
words.example: The CEO's biography will be published next spring.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位執行長的傳記將於明年春天出版。

words.definition: heading toward or intending to go to a particular place
words.example: The shipment is bound for the Kaohsiung port.
words.exampleTranslation: 這批貨物即將運往高雄港。

words.definition: a long-handled brush used for sweeping
words.example: The janitor keeps a broom in the supply closet.
words.exampleTranslation: 工友把掃把放在儲藏櫃裡。

words.definition: a hamburger with a slice of cheese added
words.example: The cafeteria added a cheeseburger to the lunch menu.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工餐廳的午餐菜單新增了起司漢堡。

words.definition: noticeably cold
words.example: Bring a jacket; the conference hall tends to be chilly.
words.exampleTranslation: 帶件外套，會議廳通常比較涼。

words.definition: a traveling company of performers that puts on shows
words.example: The city plaza will host a circus performance this weekend.
words.exampleTranslation: 這座城市廣場這週末將舉辦馬戲表演。

words.definition: goods shipped or held by one party for sale by another
words.example: The store sells clothing on consignment from local designers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間店寄售當地設計師的服飾。

words.definition: relating to a continent, especially mainland Europe
words.example: The hotel offers a continental breakfast for guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間飯店為房客提供歐陸式早餐。

words.definition: the exclusive legal right to reproduce or publish a work
words.example: The design is protected by copyright and cannot be reused.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個設計受到版權保護，不得重複使用。

words.definition: rural land away from towns and cities
words.example: The retreat took place at a hotel in the countryside.
words.exampleTranslation: 這次靜修活動在鄉間的一間飯店舉行。

words.definition: to tear down or destroy a building
words.example: The old warehouse will be demolished to make room for parking.
words.exampleTranslation: 這棟舊倉庫將被拆除以騰出停車空間。

words.definition: relating to a department within an organization
words.example: Each departmental budget must be approved by finance.
words.exampleTranslation: 每個部門的預算都必須經過財務部核准。

words.definition: feeling or showing a hopeless sense of urgency
words.example: The team made a desperate attempt to meet the deadline.
words.exampleTranslation: 團隊拼命嘗試趕上期限。

words.definition: to destroy or ruin something completely
words.example: The delay devastated the client's launch schedule.
words.exampleTranslation: 這次延誤重創了客戶的上市時程。

words.definition: relating to the diagnosis of a problem
words.example: Run a diagnostic test before shipping the device.
words.exampleTranslation: 出貨裝置前先執行診斷測試。
